sloka: अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे धर्मेण विदितात्मनि ।व्यतीता या निशा पूर्वा पौराणां हर्षवर्धिनी ।। ७.३७.१ ॥
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu kākutsthe dharmeṇa viditātmani ।vyatītā yā niśā pūrvā paurāṇāṁ harṣavardhinī ।। 7.37.1 ॥

translations.english: When Rama, whose soul was known for righteousness, had been consecrated, the first night, which increased the joy of the citizens, passed.
